info.title: AudD Music Recognition API
info.description:
The AudD music recognition API identifies songs from short audio clips
(`api.audd.io/`), large audio/video files (`enterprise.audd.io/`), and
real-time audio streams (callback or longpoll based on `api.audd.io/`).

This OpenAPI document is the canonical contract for the API. Every
official AudD SDK validates its parser against the fixtures shipped
alongside this spec.

Documentation: https://docs.audd.io
Get an api_token: https://dashboard.audd.io
Support: api@audd.io

servers.description: Standard recognition, streams and custom catalog endpoints.

post.summary: Identify a song from an audio clip (the first 12 seconds are analyzed; ≤10 MB).
post.description:
Standard music recognition. Send a file directly (multipart) or pass
a URL the AudD server downloads.

Only the first 12 seconds of the audio are analyzed. To recognize music
beyond the first 12 seconds of a file, use the enterprise endpoint
(`POST https://enterprise.audd.io/`), which scans the whole file.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the audio file. One of `url`, `file`, or `audio` is required.

file.description: Multipart file upload. One of `url`, `file`, or `audio` is required.

market.description: ISO country code for Apple Music / iTunes / Spotify regional results. Default `us`.

200.description:
Recognition processed. The response is a `success` payload (with
`result` either populated or null when no match was found) or an
`error` payload.

post.summary: Configure where AudD POSTs stream-recognition callbacks.

url.description:
Where AudD POSTs callbacks. Set to `https://audd.tech/empty/`
if you only want longpoll. The URL itself can carry a
`?return=apple_music,deezer` parameter to receive that
metadata in callbacks.

200.description:
Returns the URL or — when no callback URL has ever been
configured — error code 19 with message "Internal error".
**The SDK uses this signal to short-circuit longpoll setup.**

error.error_message: Getting the URL for callbacks failed: Internal error.

post.summary: Add a stream for live recognition.

radio_id.description: Caller-supplied identifier; must be unique per account.

callbacks.description:
Set to `before` to receive callbacks at song start.
Default is callbacks at song end (with total play length).

error.error_message: Adding a stream stream failed: authorization failed: the limit was reached. (Please check if you have an active subscription for music recognition for audio streams on https://dashboard.audd.io/ or contact us to try it for free: api@audd.io)

200.description: Returns the array of configured streams (may be empty).

post.summary: Add a song to the caller's private fingerprint catalog (NOT for music recognition).
post.description:
⚠ **This is NOT how you submit audio for music recognition.** For
recognition, use `POST /` (or `POST enterprise.audd.io/` to scan
beyond the first 12 seconds of a file). This endpoint adds a song to the caller's
private fingerprint catalog so AudD can later identify it for the
caller's account only.

Requires special access — contact api@audd.io to enable.

Calling `upload` again with the same `audio_id` re-fingerprints that
slot. There is no public list/delete endpoint; callers track
`audio_id` ↔ song mappings on their side.

audio_id.description:
Caller-supplied identifier returned alongside future
recognition results when this song is matched.

200.description: Catalog updated, or 904 if the caller's token doesn't have access.

get.summary: Long-poll for new recognition events on a category.
get.description:
Long-polls for new recognition events. The category can be derived
locally from the api_token + radio_id, or read from the
`longpoll_category` field of `getStreams`.

**Important DX caveat:** when no callback URL is configured for the
account (which the server signals via error #19 from `getCallbackUrl`),
longpoll silently returns timeout responses forever — events never
fire. Every official SDK preflights `getCallbackUrl` and raises a
descriptive error if no callback URL is set. The check is bypassable
via a `skip_callback_check` flag.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for events before returning the timeout response.

parameters.name: since_time
parameters.description: Server timestamp (ms) returned in the previous response — used to deduplicate events.

200.description:
Either a timeout response (no events) or an event response (one
or more new recognitions/notifications).

post.summary: Recognize music in large audio/video files (hours- or days-long).
post.description:
Enterprise endpoint. Send an HTTPS URL or a multipart file (streamed,
no in-memory buffering needed). The endpoint chunks the audio into
12-second segments and counts each scanned chunk as 1 request.

SDKs default to a 1-hour read timeout for this endpoint and enable TCP
keepalive on the transport.

return.description:
Comma-separated metadata identifiers. Same as the standard
endpoint — but **Spotify is NOT supported** on enterprise.

accurate_offsets.description: When 'true', return per-match start/end offsets within each 12-second chunk.

skip.description: Number of 12-second chunks to skip after each scanned chunk.

every.description: Number of consecutive chunks to scan.

limit.description:
Upper bound on the number of chunks to recognize. **Always
set this in dev/test environments to control cost.**

use_timecode.description:
When 'true', use the `t`/`time_continue`/`start` URL parameter
of the source URL as `skip_first_seconds`. Mutually exclusive
with `skip_first_seconds`.

200.description: Recognition processed. JSON or CSV depending on `response_type`.

api_token_form.name: api_token
api_token_form.description:
AudD authentication uses the `api_token` parameter sent either as a
multipart/form-data field (POST) or as a query parameter (GET/POST).
OpenAPI 3.1 has no first-class scheme for "auth in request body"; this
entry documents the parameter for code generators that recognize it.

api_token_query.name: api_token
api_token_query.description: api_token sent as a query parameter (works on every endpoint).

RecognitionResult.description:
A single recognition result. Shape varies by which catalog matched:

* Public-DB match — fields like `artist`, `title`, `album`,
  `release_date`, `label`, `song_link` are populated; `audio_id` is
  absent.
* Custom-DB match (caller's private fingerprint catalog) — only
  `timecode` and `audio_id` are populated; the public-DB fields are
  absent.

The SDK exposes `is_custom_match` / `is_public_match` discriminator
helpers and a `thumbnail_url` helper that returns
`{song_link}?thumb` only when the host of `song_link` is `lis.tn`.

timecode.description: Position in the recognized song (MM:SS) at which the matched fragment plays.

audio_id.description: Custom-DB match identifier. Mutually exclusive with the public-DB fields in practice.

song_link.description:
Canonical AudD link to the song page. For lis.tn-hosted links,
appending `?thumb` returns the cover-art image.

AppleMusicMetadata.description:
Mirror of the upstream Apple Music track payload. AudD passes it
through verbatim, so SDK consumers can rely on additional fields
appearing here as Apple ships them.

DeezerMetadata.description: Mirror of the upstream Deezer track payload. May be absent for some tracks.

NapsterMetadata.description: Mirror of the upstream Napster track payload. May be absent for some tracks.

MusicBrainzEntry.description:
Single MusicBrainz recording match. AudD returns an array of these
because MusicBrainz's matching often surfaces multiple candidates.

SpotifyMetadata.description: Mirror of the upstream Spotify track payload.

longpoll_category.description:
Pre-derived 9-character longpoll category for this stream.
Equivalent to MD5(MD5(api_token) + str(radio_id))[:9].
Safe to share with clients (browser/widget) — no token leakage.

StreamMutationSuccessResponse.description: Common shape returned by setCallbackUrl, addStream, setStreamUrl, deleteStream.

StreamCallbackResultBody.description:
Inner shape of the recognition-result callback variant — the value
of the top-level `result` field. Holds the matched songs, the
stream identifier, and per-event metadata.

play_length.description: Seconds the song was played in the stream. Absent when callbacks=before.

StreamCallbackResultEnvelope.description:
Recognition-result variant of the wire payload AudD POSTs to the
user's callback URL. Wraps `StreamCallbackResultBody` inside a
`{status: "success", result: ...}` envelope.

StreamCallbackNotification.description:
Notification variant of the callback payload. Sent when AudD's stream
recognition encounters a problem (connection failure, no music
detected, recovered) — separate from a recognition result. Has its
own top-level shape with `status: "-"`.

notification_code.description:
* 0 — healthy
* 650 — can't connect to the stream
* 651 — only white noise / no music detected

StreamCallbackPayload.description:
Wire format the SDK's `streams.parse_callback(...)` consumes — either
a recognition-result envelope or a notification.

LongpollTimeoutResponse.description:
Returned when the longpoll wait elapsed without new events. The
client should issue a new request using `timestamp` as the next
`since_time`.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp (ms) — pass as `since_time` on the next request.

LongpollEventResponse.description:
Returned when one or more new recognition events fired during the
wait. Carries the same per-event shape as a callback payload (either
a `StreamCallbackResultBody` under `result`, or a notification block
under `notification`) plus a `timestamp` to use as the next
`since_time`. Tightening this oneOf during Phase 1 once a real fixture
is captured.

LongpollResponse.description:
Use `anyOf` rather than `oneOf` because both branches use
`additionalProperties: true` and a timeout response (`timeout` +
`timestamp`) trivially also satisfies the event-response branch
(which only requires `timestamp`). SDKs disambiguate by presence
of the `timeout` field.

timecode.description: Position in the original song (MM:SS) where the matched fragment plays.

start_offset.description: Position (milliseconds) within the 12-second chunk where the match begins.

end_offset.description: Position (milliseconds) within the 12-second chunk where the match ends.

offset.description: Position (MM:SS) in the submitted file at which this 12-second chunk begins.

execution_time.description: Wall-clock execution time on the server.

error_code.description:
AudD-specific numeric error code. The SDK maps each code to a
typed exception class (see audd-<lang>/docs/errors.md). The
full set: 19, 20, 31337, 40, 50, 51, 100, 300, 400, 500, 600,
601, 602, 610, 611, 700, 701, 702, 900, 901, 902, 903, 904,
905, 906, 907, 1000.

error_message.description: Human-readable, server-provided. Already includes any subscription-nudge appendix.

request_params.description:
Server's redacted echo of the request parameters. The api_token
field is masked (e.g., "d***e"). Standard endpoint uses this field
name; the enterprise endpoint uses `requested_params` (see below).

requested_params.description:
Same as `request_params` but with this alternate name as returned
by the enterprise endpoint. SDKs should normalize these into one
field on the SDK-side error object.

request_api_method.description:
Humanized echo of the API method (e.g., "Recognition", "Adding a
stream stream", "Getting the URL for callbacks"). Informational
only — not a programmatic discriminator.

execution_time.description: Wall-clock execution time on the server (enterprise endpoint only).

result.description:
For most errors, omitted. For codes 19 and 31337, the server may
populate a "branded" result with `artist`/`title` strings — the
SDK surfaces these on the exception's `branded_message` field
and does NOT expose them as a recognition result.
